primary_endpoint: Absolute change from baseline in liver fat percentage by MRI-PDFF at 12 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: Liver fat change: Part B vonafexor 100 mg QD −6.3 vs placebo −2.3 (p=0.0015); 200 mg QD −5.4 vs −2.3 (p=0.0121). Part A pooled vonafexor −4.7 vs placebo +3.9 (p=0.0371).
safety_signal: Serious AEs: Part A, 0/6–0/7 across groups; Part B, placebo 1/32, vonafexor 100 mg QD 1/31, and 200 mg QD 2/33. No deaths reported.
